name: USA₮
oneLiner: USAT is Tether's GENIUS-era U.S. dollar stablecoin, issued 1:1 by Anchorage Digital Bank with reserves custodied at Cantor Fitzgerald.
collateral: Cash and reverse repurchase agreements collateralized by U.S. Treasuries, held for USAT reserves under Anchorage Digital Bank issuance.
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption through Tether/Anchorage Digital Bank

applicabilityBasis.summary: USAT is publicly described as a U.S. dollar-backed token with 1:1 redemption through Tether and Anchorage Digital Bank, marketed explicitly as a GENIUS Act-compliant payment stablecoin.

genius.notes: Anchorage Digital Bank is an uninsured OCC-chartered national trust bank (the first federally chartered crypto bank, chartered January 2021). Under the GENIUS Act, this corresponds to the federal qualified payment stablecoin issuer (FQPSI) pathway supervised by the OCC. Anchorage has submitted a comment letter on the OCC NPRM and publicly states it expects to become a PPSI once the GENIUS Act framework takes effect (rules still in proposed-rulemaking stage as of 2026-06-18). No PPSI approval has been granted to any issuer. The OCC's proposed rule raises a potential 'one issuer, one brand' restriction that could affect Anchorage's white-label model (it currently issues USAT, USDtb/Ethena, USDGO/OSL, and a forthcoming USDPT/Western Union).

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No PPSI approval, state-qualified status, or official GENIUS Act application has been publicly filed or granted for Anchorage Digital Bank or USAT as of 2026-06-18. Anchorage explicitly uses forward-looking language ('expects to become a PPSI') confirming intent, not approval. The GENIUS Act rulemaking remains at the NPRM stage with no final rules issued.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: USAT proxies to an implementation that imports WithBlockedList.sol (Tether-family blocked-list/freeze surface) and is upgradeable via a TransparentUpgradeableProxy admin.

mintAuthority.summary: USAT's verified HadronToken source exposes owner-only mint and redeem functions. The token and its transparent ProxyAdmin are both controlled immediately by the same legacy 3/5 multisig contract.

controls.label: USAT owner-only minter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526649, the USAT proxy owner() and ProxyAdmin owner() both returned this address. required() returned 3 and getOwners() returned five current legacy multisig owner slots: 0x6744A526..., 0x106743fD..., 0xD3Fc71bD..., 0x68298631..., and 0x1e1Ed372.... Verified HadronToken source exposes mint(address,uint256), redeem(uint256), and destroyBlockedFunds as owner-only functions.

sources.label: OCC active regional and midsize institutions

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526649, the EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots resolved to implementation 0x8b98bcd9b1f8ae112fb2b58b45c3bc9a75cc4d0e and ProxyAdmin 0x3e4c6460aa00c11c81e3c5b95b15d612f5f2d9c7. ProxyAdmin.owner() and token owner() both returned the same reviewed legacy multisig, whose current required() value is 3 and getOwners() returned five signers. The verified HadronToken source confirms owner-only mint and redeem authority; ProxyAdmin source exposes immediate owner-only upgrades with no timelock. On 2026-07-15, Anchorage's primary transparency page listed monthly Big Four AICPA attestations for January through May 2026 and identified Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. as issuer; the OCC's current institution list independently confirmed the active national bank. USAT is therefore periodically reconciled and prudentially supervised, while its no-delay issuer-controlled mint is economically unbounded.
